name: Avantor, Inc.

groups.label: Single 180-day lock-up, no early release: employees, officers and directors alike
groups.groupQuote: We, our executive officers, directors and certain holders of our common stock, including the selling stockholder, prior to this offering have agreed with the underwriters, subject to certain exceptions, not to dispose of or hedge any shares of our common stock or securities convertible into or exchangeable for shares of common stock during the period from the date of this prospectus continuing through the date 180 days after the date of this prospectus, except with the prior written consent of Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and J.P. Morgan Securities LLC.
groups.groupNote: The filing says 'certain holders' without listing them; an ordinary non-officer employee is modelled as inside the lock-up (both reads assumed the same). The card has no founder in the usual sense (CEO Michael Stubblefield is a hired CEO); the founder seat uses the same terms.

tranches.readB: 100% through day 180 (Tue 2019-11-12), first sale day Wed 2019-11-13 -> 2019-11-13
tranches.reconcilerNote: Reads agree on every field (pct, trigger, resolvedDate, page). Differences are cosmetic: ids, A's shortened quote (B's is the full sentence, used here and checked verbatim against research/424b4/c5.txt p.198), and page typed as string in B. Date recomputed: prospectus date 2019-05-16 + 180 calendar days = Tue 2019-11-12; the lock-up runs 'through' that date, so the first sale day is the next trading day, Wed 2019-11-13, which is in base.json prices.

reveal.text: Avantor priced its IPO on May 16, 2019 at $14 a share and closed its first day at $14.50. The stock fell to a low of $8.27 on March 18, 2020 in the pandemic crash, peaked at $44.01 on September 24, 2021, and closed the five years at $24.93 on May 20, 2024, 78.1% above the offer price. Its filings show steady sales and profit growth, helped by pandemic demand, and steady debt reduction.

notes: Four Item 2.02 8-Ks are preliminary-revenue updates, not quarterly results: 2020-07-07, 2020-10-23, 2021-01-11, 2021-10-12. Lockup readers: do not count them as an earnings release for an afterEarnings trigger.
